Prefer audited view-as sessions with visible banners over password sharing for provider/student inspection.

expanded_phrases.million-dollar: Founder-demo-quality UI with consistent controls, clear information architecture, role-scoped data, complete state handling, mobile/tablet/desktop proof, and deploy/live smoke before Done.
expanded_phrases.million dollar app: Same as million-dollar: not a slogan, a verified quality gate with screenshots, state matrix, action registry, privacy checks, and live proof.
expanded_phrases.professional: Consistent typography, spacing, button sizing, alignment, copy, active states, empty/error/loading states, and no debug-looking UI in normal role views.
expanded_phrases.configured: Setup/readiness diagnostics must be explicit in Super Admin/support surfaces and hidden or summarized in normal provider/student views.
expanded_phrases.working: Actions must either function, be disabled with reason, be preview-only, or be support-only; no ambiguous dead buttons.
expanded_phrases.CRM: First-party contact/activity/task/pipeline patterns inside BNA only; no external CRM runtime is introduced.
expanded_phrases.pipeline: Visible stages, filters, counts, ownership, next action, empty states, and activity history, scoped to the selected workspace.
expanded_phrases.clean: No clutter, random diagnostics, raw provider payloads, internal IDs, unaligned buttons, or mixed role-specific controls.
expanded_phrases.logical filters: Filters must match the user's mental model, show active state and counts, avoid duplicate categories, and preserve workspace/project scope.
expanded_phrases.random displays: Support/debug/configuration details must be moved to Super Admin diagnostics or support drawers, not normal account views.
expanded_phrases.production ready app: Role-specific UI that looks complete, handles all states, protects privacy, and has screenshots/tests/live smoke.

product_quality_expansion.first_party_pattern_interpretation: CRM/pipeline/community-style requests mean first-party BNA product patterns and registries only, not external CRM runtime.
compiled_quality_standard: Equal and aligned buttons across audited views.
Logical filter labels, counts, active states, and empty states.
Provider account view shows provider-relevant product UI, not global setup clutter.
Super Admin has diagnostics/readiness in Operations support surfaces.
Student view-as path is audited and private.
